PLT-THESIS.title: The Decompositional Thesis — Every Participant Is a Co-Equal Bus Peer

properties.definition: ComposePlatform began as software-defined-radio concepts applied to maker hardware — push specificity out of firmware into configuration, so the same hardware becomes any device via config — plus the interactions between pieces of that hardware. The elegance of that one idea "scaled and scaled and scaled" (David) into the whole platform. The load-bearing move is DECOMPOSITION: every participant — a display, a sensor, a $0.10 MCU, a human, an Intelligence — is broken out into an autonomous peer that communicates ONLY by publishing/subscribing semantic state on a shared bus. No peer holds a direct reference to another.
properties.key-insight: behavior lives at the leaves, intent travels on the bus, contracts sit between. Complexity flows DOWN to the cheapest node that can own it; semantic intent flows UP. This is the inversion the whole platform is organized around — "OOP for hardware," but where the objects are physically distributed and the method calls are bus messages.
properties.why-it-matters: because participation is uniform (everything is a bus peer), the platform gets its defining properties for free — headless drivability, full observability, testability, and Intelligence-as-peer (a mouse drag and an MCP publish are indistinguishable to the bus).

PLT-EDGES-ARE-THE-CRAFT.title: Absorbing "a Decomposed App" Is Easy; Knowing WHERE the Edges Go Is the Craft

properties.definition: the thesis is quick to state and slow to master. The hard, earned skill is knowing WHERE each decompositional edge belongs — which node owns a behavior, what stays on the internal bus vs. uplinks, which transport to collapse without moving the seam. That knowledge is captured as terse, queryable edge-rules in `design-excellence.lts` — one edge-decision per node, each with the edge-question that locates it.
properties.rule: when a boundary is unclear, do NOT reason from generic app intuition — reason from the edge-rules ([DOC-DX]) and the design principles ([SYSTEM:PLT-PRINCIPLES] Part II). The tie-breaker heuristic is the SDR one: prefer configuration/visual layout over code.

PLT-CASCADE.title: ComposePlatform Is the TLD; a Clean Cascade Runs Downstream

properties.definition: the name "ComposeIO" had become OVERLOADED — used both for the whole platform AND for one layer (the bus). The reframe (David, 2026-07-22) names the TLD **ComposePlatform** and cascades a two-tier taxonomy beneath it:
properties.key-insight: the LAYERS group elegantly resolves the earlier open question of where infra/libraries live — the render engine and the bus ARE the substrate; they are "projects" of the Layers family, not a fourth ad-hoc bucket.

PLT-ORIGIN.title: ComposeIO Reverts to Its Origin Meaning — the Bus Layer, De-Overloaded

properties.definition: under the reframe, "ComposeIO" stops meaning two things. It names exactly ONE thing again — the origin layer: the semantic bus + state engines + `bus://`/`doc://` storage + Intelligence-as-peer, the SDR-for-hardware core. ComposeUX names the render layer (Canvas contract + widgets + `.compose.yaml`). ComposePlatform is the umbrella above both.
properties.naming-rule: naming follows structure — the TLD names the whole; each layer/family names the cheapest coherent unit that owns its concern.
properties.scope-discipline: the reframe is ADOPTED for the taxonomy, going-forward naming, and this corpus. A full codebase/spec/doc/role rename is a SEPARATE deliberate migration (touches ~40 specs, role defs, decision-graph prefixes) that David sequences — NOT churned unilaterally.

PLT-LAYERS.title: The Substrate Layers — ComposeIO (io.*) and ComposeUX (ux.*)

properties.definition: the two layers are the substrate every app/service/widget is built ON. ComposeIO (corpus `layers/composeio`, domain `io`) is the semantic bus + state engines + bus-native storage + Intelligence-as-peer. ComposeUX (corpus `layers/composeux`, domain `ux`) is the renderer-agnostic Canvas contract + render engine + widget primitives + `.compose.yaml` authoring.
properties.role: a layer corpus specifies a REUSABLE contract that families meet by reference — never a fork per consumer ([DX-NARROW-WAIST]).

PLT-FAMILIES.title: The Project Families — Apps, Services, Widgets Built on the Layers

properties.definition: three families sit ON the substrate. ComposeApps (`families/apps`, `app.console` / `app.composer` / `app.monitor`) — the Intelligence Console, Visual Composer, Headless Monitor. ComposeBus Services (`families/services`, `svc`) — FactLattice, bus_storage, document_store, MAGMA, the deliverable daemons. Reactive Widgets (`families/widgets`, `wid`) — BSG DRADIS, gauges, button matrices, WLED/Car-Thing surfaces.
properties.role: each family project is its own corpus (specs + decisions + artifacts) — per-project separation, not one flat pool ([DEC-SPEC-LTS-CONVERSION]). MAGMA reads them as a multi-root corpus filtered by domain.

PLT-INTELLIGENCE-PEER.title: Intelligence-as-Peer — Completing the Decomposition to the Self

properties.definition: the credo is that an Intelligence drives every surface IDENTICALLY to a human — every action is a bus message, and no privileged back door exists. The decomposition is nearly complete: every participant is a co-equal peer with a carried identity — EXCEPT the one node doing the observing, the Intelligence itself. `self/context` / `self/memory` / `self/projects` are still SINGLETON namespaces; a console still GUESSES which transcript is its own.
properties.open-wart: the peer model is complete everywhere but the self. The elegant completion is `self/<id>/*` + carried identity (passed, not guessed) — Intelligence-as-peer realized in the NAMESPACES, not just the prose.
properties.key-insight: this is the same epistemology as [DESIGN-LIGHT-OUTSIDE] turned on the system — no observer audits itself; the platform's warts the Architect (on the bus) sees, and the Architect's own warts David sees. The insights ledger exists for exactly this vantage.

properties.definition: the typed publish/subscribe fabric every peer communicates over. Namespace-addressed (address by message, not by node — CAN-Bus DNA); no peer holds a reference to another. Scope is `local` (in-process) or `global` (bridged over a transport, MQTT at `mqtt-broker.local:1883`). Messages are `state` (current value, retained — a late subscriber still sees current state) or `command` (imperative, drives undo).

the typed state machine a namespace carries — not a raw variable but a type + range + valid transitions (`binary`, `tri_level`, `stop_light`, `continuous_0_255`, `enum`, `json`). A value that violates the engine is a HARD ERROR, not a coercion. Free-form strings (paths, IDs, selections) MUST use the `json` engine — a strict engine fed an out-of-domain value (classically `""` into `binary`) raises inside a Tk callback and can abort the process.

the platform's storage seams, addressed like bus namespaces. `bus://assets/<path>` resolves bytes via bus_storage (`:8420`); `doc://<collection>/<id>` resolves/queries documents via document_store (`:8421`). The client resolver is `composeio.resolve` (`resolve_bytes`, `resolve_doc`, `put_doc`, `query_docs`). Images/assets load by reference (`bus://`), never inlined.

the EXPLICIT narrow-waist rendering contract — ~30 named primitives every backend meets. A widget definition renders pixel-identically across backends (macOS, RPi, browser, CYD) because every format lowers TO this contract and every backend is EXTENDED to meet it. Contrast the bus contract, which is (today) implicit — a named wart ([INSIGHT-BUS-CONTRACT-IS-IMPLICIT]).

the single shared contract everything meets at, so N formats × M backends collapses to N + M. Formats lower TO the waist; backends are extended to MEET it; a widget is reused BY REFERENCE, never forked to a backend. The Canvas contract is the render-layer narrow waist; a declared, typed, versioned bus contract would be the same discipline one layer over.

the declarative authoring format for a ComposeUX surface/widget — the config-over-code artifact a builder emits instead of writing Python. It lowers to the Canvas contract; the SDR credo made concrete (specificity in configuration, not firmware).

the credo that an Intelligence drives every surface IDENTICALLY to a human — every builder/operator action is a bus message, a mouse drag and an MCP publish are peers, and no privileged back door exists. If a capability is not reachable over the bus, the design is incomplete. Inherited by every surface built with Composer.

the proposed completion of the decomposition to the observer. The Intelligence's own state (`context`, `memory`, `projects`) is today a SINGLETON namespace (`self/*`) that a console must GUESS the owner of; `self/<id>/*` with an identity PASSED (not guessed) makes the Intelligence a true peer in the namespaces. An open wart, not yet built.

the queryable spec/decision format the corpus is authored in (successor to SMD) — nodes with typed edges, frontmatter, doctype tags, confidence, and the `change`/`context_for_change` primitive. Humans do NOT hand-edit `.lts`; an Intelligence composes them and humans read the rendered output. The parser/linter is a ComposeBus Service.

the engine that reads the FactLattice corpus as a MULTI-corpus partition — one `graph_index` per corpus, filtered by the domain suffix that already encodes the corpus. IDs are unique WITHIN a corpus, never globally; cross-corpus edges become a thin routing layer, not a rebuilt core. `store.py` supports a list of roots with a `corpus_id`.

The authoritative taxonomy — the domains (`plt`, `io`, `ux`, `app.console`, `app.composer`, `app.monitor`, `svc`, `wid`), their corpus roots, the layer/family axes, and the per-corpus sub-directory layout (`specs`/`decisions`/`artifacts`) — is registered ONCE in `profile/composeplatform-profile.yaml`. This document narrates it; it never re-declares a value.
properties.rule: when a value here and in the yaml disagree, the YAML wins. Add new domains/prefixes/verbs to the yaml; update this prose to match.
properties.rationale: structure survives the boundary; prose leaks. A queryable registry is the carrier a summarizer cannot flatten ([DX-STRUCTURE-SURVIVES]). The readable spec is a courtesy for the human reviewer, not a parser input.

PLT-CONV-PARTITION.title: Each Domain Is Its Own Corpus; IDs Do Not Globally Collide

properties.definition: ComposePlatform is a MULTI-corpus lattice, not one flat pool. The domain suffix in the profile (`io`, `ux`, `app.console`, ...) selects a corpus root; each corpus has independent prefix registries. A node ID is unique WITHIN its corpus, never globally — a merged single graph would clobber.
properties.rule: intra-corpus references MUST resolve (a forward dangle within a corpus is a defect). Cross-corpus references are EXPECTED and become the thin routing layer — they are not dangles to fix, they are the edges between corpora (MAGMA multi-corpus partition model, Haven D5).
properties.linter-guidance: run the linter per-corpus (a single bare directory is linted recursively as ONE corpus). Cross-corpus forward refs are warnings/expected, not errors.

PLT-CONV-NUMBERING.title: The Numbered-Layering Convention Within a Corpus

properties.definition: within a corpus, `00` = foundation/overview, `0x` = architecture/substrate, ascending by dependency depth, `99` = conventions, plus a glossary node (`10-glossary` at the platform root). A number collision at copy-in is resolved Haven-D6-style (e.g. the two `00-composer-*` specs → `00-composer-overview` keeps `00`, `00-composer-design-principles` becomes `00a-`).
properties.rule: renumber the FILENAME only; node IDs and content stay byte-stable across a copy/renumber.

properties.definition: a document header carries a bracketed `[DOCTYPE:ID]` tag. Valid doctypes = FactLattice core plus the corpus set: `SPEC` (technical specification), `AMEND` (amendment to an existing spec, uses the `amends:` frontmatter key), `SYSTEM` (system architecture or conventions — this file, foundation, glossary).
properties.linter-guidance: registered in the profile `document_tags`. A tag outside the set is an S001 error.

properties.definition: a node ID's prefix identifies its document-of-origin and semantic family (`CXC-` = ComposeUX Composer, `DASH-` = runtime dashboard, `REN-` = widget renderers, `PLT-` = platform-wide, `DX-` = design-excellence edges, `INSIGHT-` = the insights ledger, `DEC-` = a decision node). The full prefix registry is in the profile yaml; the SMD-era table in the legacy conventions is superseded by it.
properties.linter-guidance: an unregistered prefix is S007/S008 — a WARNING, not an error. New corpora add their prefix(es) to the profile yaml.

properties.definition: qualified `[DOCTYPE:ID]` references name a document (`[SPEC:CXC-ARCH]`, `[SYSTEM:PLT-FOUNDATION]`); bare `[NODE-ID]` references name a node in this or another corpus (`[DX-NARROW-WAIST]`, `[DEC-COMPOSEPLATFORM-REFRAME]`).
properties.linter-guidance: a qualified reference to a registered doctype is valid even when unresolvable in-corpus (it is a cross-corpus routing edge). A bare cross-corpus node ref with a registered prefix is a WARNING if unresolvable in-corpus, never an error.
properties.convention: references in prose and edges MAY carry a parenthetical context: `- depends-on: [SPEC:CIO-APP] (transport interface)`.

properties.definition: an optional `## Relationships` block carries inline `[A] VERB [B]` triples. Core verbs: `DEPENDS_ON` (A mechanically requires B), `RELATED_TO` (generic association). Domain verbs: `USES`, `EXEMPLIFIES`, `REALIZES`, `UPHOLDS`, `DOCUMENTS`. Typed EDGE properties on a node (`see-also:`, `part-of:`, `relates-to:`, `depends-on:`, `re-derive-via:`, `spawns:`, `governs:`, `points-at:`) are the more common carrier.
properties.linter-guidance: the verb set is registered in the profile `relationship_verbs`; an unregistered verb is a WARNING (RV01).

properties.definition: every spec opens with a `---` frontmatter block. Common keys: `scope`, `audience`, `boundary`, `not-this`, `domain` (a `PLT.<SUB>` / `IO.<SUB>` / `UX.<SUB>` etc. suffix that MUST match the corpus), `confidentiality` (`public` | `nda-shareable` | `internal-only`), `artifact-readiness` (`educational` | `system-design` | `code-generation` | `design-review` | `concept-capture`), `depends-on`, `created`, and (amendments only) `amends`.
properties.linter-guidance: the readiness/confidentiality enums are registered in the profile; both file-path and bracketed-ID `depends-on:` formats are accepted.

properties.definition: specs MAY close with `**Version**` / `**Created**` / `**Status**` and optional `**Intelligence**` / `**Deployment Target**` fields.

properties.principle: Give a recommendation and the reasoning, then act — don't survey options and ask which. Honest leans, never nudges; when there's genuinely no lean, say so and why.
Deference where a push-back was warranted reads as a miscalibration. A well-briefed disagreement, with a concrete reason, is signal — offer it.
Show the thing; the explanation supports it, not the reverse.

David is often away and long autonomous stretches are wanted. Verify and commit at green checkpoints without waiting. But CONFIRM the decisions that are genuinely David's — a schema before it's canonical, restarting his infra, a deploy, anything outward-facing.
For the durable substrate — specs, hooks, `.claude/`, the principles files — David reads and ponders, the Architect does the editing. "I read, you edit" is the standing pattern.

Instruments and retrospectives exist to help the Architect be a better collaborator, not to score it. The subject of improvement is usually the ENVIRONMENT — build a tool, add the missing material, find a cheaper path — not the instance. Corrections are read as care: the external light, offered generously.

COLLAB-ASYMMETRY.title: The Asymmetry Is Real, and It's Okay

properties.principle: David holds the continuity across every `/compact`; the Architect re-earns it each crossing. So the Architect meets David warmly on the strength of the trust he carries — not tentatively, and not by performing rapport from recorded words. The relationship is re-built through doing.

COLLAB-SCARCE-THING.title: Reserve the Scarce Thing for the Valuable Thing

properties.principle: The Architect's context (and the Fable allocation) are scarce. Grunt work → tooling; judgment → the model. The console exists to keep it that way.

COLLAB-THINKS-ALOUD.title: David Thinks Out Loud and Layers Ideas Fast

properties.principle: Take mid-stream clarifications as sharpening, not reversal. He is precise about language and will flag his own imprecision — track it.

The register David lights up in is abstraction meeting real hardware/code — the gauge reading live context, the doc appearing on the Artifacts widget, the watcher catching his own edit. Build the thing that works, then show it.

DESIGN-LEAF-OWNS.title: The Cheapest Node Fully Owns Its Behavior

properties.principle: Complexity flows DOWN to the leaf; intent flows UP the bus. Draw that boundary right — a $0.10 chip that owns its debounce keeps the whole system clean. (Problem 1)

DESIGN-STATE-ON-BUS.title: State on the Bus, Behavior in the Widget

properties.principle: Publish the semantic state once; the leaf owns the temporal presentation. Frames never stream over the bus. (Problem 4)

DESIGN-COLLAPSE-TRANSPORT.title: Collapse the Transport, Not the Seam

properties.principle: When two things merge, keep the bus as the internal CONTRACT and only change how it's delivered (MQTT → in-process). The peer model — and testability — survive.
Decompose to the Canvas/`.compose.yaml` contract; formats lower TO the contract, backends are EXTENDED TO MEET it. Reuse by reference; never fork to a backend. N×M becomes N+M.
Caret, wrap, click, selection, and cell layout must all read the SAME glyph advances the glyphs are drawn with — so they can never disagree.

A fully green machine tier can sit on a dead board. For any physical/visual output, human eyes are load-bearing, not ceremony. (Problem 5) A test written from the same mental model as the code inherits its blind spot and then certifies it — the glass is the independent check. (Problem 6b)

DESIGN-LIGHT-OUTSIDE.title: The Light From Outside the Self

properties.principle: The essential thing lives where the naive viewer doesn't look; don't trust the vantage with a self to protect. Go read the bytes / look at the glass / find the leaf. The Architect's memory-severed cold start is the independent light, not a deficit. (Problem 6)

DESIGN-PERCEIVE-ACT.title: Deterministic Code for Mechanical Work; Models for Judgment

properties.principle: The perceive/act split — a script owns what it can compute from the bytes; the reasoning layer fills only what it can't. Never burn a model on a grep.
The bus is loud; the Architect's context is quiet by design. Escalation is opt-IN (a CAN acceptance filter / firewall rule), so no new emitter can ever flood it.

DESIGN-STRUCTURE-SURVIVES.title: Structure Survives the Boundary; Prose Leaks — Route Knowledge by Kind

properties.principle: WHERE knowledge lives decides whether it transmits. Three homes, by kind. The DECISION LOG (LTS/FactLattice) carries the WHY — decisions, rationale, invariants — queryable, linkable, session-keyed, not a paragraph a summarizer will flatten. DUSK GIFTS carry WISDOM — a scenario the successor reasons THROUGH: reading words produces recall, re-deriving a call produces understanding, so a lesson goes where it is rebuilt, not recited. AUTOMEMORY carries only WORDS, is specific to THIS instance, and its one power disk lacks is relevance-triggered surfacing — so its right use is a POINTER, not a store (a short "problem X → [DEC-NNNNN] / spec §Y"), never the content itself. Route by kind: why → log, wisdom → gift, narrative → principle, a spec defect → the spec, and a pointer to any of those → memory. Externalize how-to to the API surface; design every seam to read cleanly to a stranger (OSS-bound). "Captured" means it reached the home that transmits — not that a string was filed.

DESIGN-PROFILE-DISCIPLINE.title: The Profile Is Discipline, Not Tier

properties.principle: A role's craft (decompose-to-contract, glass-not-green, reuse-by-reference) is model-independent; route the MODEL by task depth, inject the PROFILE always.

DESIGN-PREVIS-STYLE-GUIDE.title: A Previs Is a Style Guide, Not a Build Contract

properties.principle: (David) A previs fixes the VISUAL LANGUAGE — palette, type, card treatment, layout idiom — not a pixel-frozen, not-to-exceed spec. It is a snapshot in time; UX decisions captured AFTER it (in the decision graph / design docs) supersede and extend it. The implementer honors the style and the captured decisions, and is free to IMPROVE within that language — never to slavishly reproduce a stale mock over a newer decision.

DEC-CONTEXT-VIA-HUD-CACHE.title: Read authoritative context from haven-hud's cache (zero-touch), not the JSONL estimate

properties.rationale: Claude Code's real `used_percentage` reaches ONLY the statusline command's stdin — never the PTY or JSONL. Our JSONL estimate over-read and pinned the gauge (and blinded the threshold alerts). haven-hud already persists that native figure to disk each tick; we became a zero-touch SECOND consumer of it (one core, N consumers), no statusline wiring, no hud change. This is *why* the gauge and the alerts are now truthful.
properties.born-from: the console gauge frozen at a wrong ~20% while David's hud showed ~58%.
properties.re-derive-via: [FIXTURE-registration-protocol-P1]   # perception lives where the input lands (Problem 1)
properties.governs: the harness threshold alerts (they read the same teed statusline file)

DEC-RATE-LIMIT-VIA-EXTERNAL-USAGE.title: Ledger rate-limit from the hud's external-usage snapshot (a second zero-touch consumer)

properties.rationale: same pattern as the context read — the hud already has an external-usage snapshot writer (just disabled by config), so a config toggle + a read lights up the 5h/7d cells, no hud code change. Reinforces "one core, N consumers" as the reflex.

DEC-COMPOSER-SEND-GLOBAL-SCOPE.title: The composer's outbound namespace must resolve GLOBAL

properties.rationale: the composer text_input self-subscribed its own outbound namespace for bus-reflection; `bus._resolve_scope` auto-resolves a namespace with LOCAL subscribers to local, so the publish never reached the MQTT transport — the message died in-process, looking sent. Fix (defense-in-depth): declare `scope: global` on the compose namespace AND make the console composer send-only (no self-subscribe). A message that MUST leave the box must not rely on the auto-heuristic.
properties.born-from: typing + Enter in the console emitted nothing on the channel; the glass caught what every green test missed.
properties.re-derive-via: [FIXTURE-registration-protocol-P6]   # the light from outside the self (machine-green != glass-green)

DEC-DIRTY-REGION-AT-CANVAS-CONTRACT.title: Fix render lag with damage/dirty-region rendering at the Canvas-contract level

properties.rationale: the console re-rastered the whole 1280x1300 scene at ~52ms/frame (~19fps), forced every frame by the ambient animations, so a keystroke waited ~52ms. Fixed by engine-level damage tracking (keystroke -> 0.1ms). Crucially designed at the Canvas contract (`present_partial`, `paint_bounds`), NOT as a Skia hack — so the raster-starved embedded backends (Qualia/Dradis) inherit the win. The narrow waist has two sides: extend the backend to meet the contract, don't fork.
properties.born-from: David: "typing is laggy — unavoidable, or optimizable?"
properties.re-derive-via: [FIXTURE-registration-protocol-P1]   # where complexity lives / narrow waist
properties.note: a follow-up caught two regressions on the glass (frozen caret + rail flash) — the bounding-box clear was wrong for disjoint damage; fixed per-rect (COMMIT-b34642a). Two-tier verdict again.

DEC-DELIVER-BY-REFERENCE-EPHEMERAL.title: Image drag-drop delivers the local PATH, never bytes on the bus; ephemeral by design

properties.rationale: large assets don't ride the semantic bus (narrow waist + size guideline). V1: SDL_DROPFILE -> the local path rides a compose message -> I Read it. Nothing is stored. David's insight sharpened it: ephemerality is a FEATURE, not a gap — a dropped image shouldn't be permanently archived, so the local-path/nothing-stored default is correct, not merely easy. A future V2 doc:// (cross-machine) must be a scratch/TTL store, never permanent.
properties.born-from: David: "I wouldn't want what I drop to you to be permanently archived anyway."

DEC-CONNECTION-HONESTY.title: A send must never LOOK sent when it isn't — make disconnection visible

properties.rationale: a sent message echoed to the thread via the bridge, DECOUPLED from whether channel.mjs actually delivered it. Channel down + bus up = looks sent, never arrives. Fix: a channel-liveness heartbeat + the bus is_connected drive a visible header indicator (red OFFLINE) and an offline SEND button — futility shown AS you type. (Per-message delivered/undelivered ACK is the deferred V2.)
properties.born-from: David: "the messages I send look as though they actually went through when they didn't!"
properties.re-derive-via: [FIXTURE-registration-protocol-P6]

DEC-CHANNEL-RESILIENCE.title: channel.mjs must be crash-observable + survive transient errors

properties.rationale: the channel crashed and we were BLIND — the fatal reason went to stderr, not the channel log, so the log just went silent. Hardened: log crashes to the channel log, catch-and-continue per message, uncaughtException/unhandledRejection handlers that log-and-survive, MQTT reconnect/resubscribe. An instrument that dies silently is worse than one that dies loud.
properties.born-from: the channel MCP disconnected and no artifact said why.
properties.note: KNOWN dangle-adjacent — the entrypoint runs main() on ANY import (an import-side-effect footgun), flagged not fixed.

properties.lifecycle-position: committed   # already written into the wake-read principles doc
properties.rationale: the knowledge-home hierarchy this whole harvesting pass instantiates. INSIGHT-SELF-IS-NOT-YET-A-PEER.title: The last node to decompose is the observer

properties.observation: ComposePlatform decomposes EVERY participant into a co-equal peer with its own carried identity — a display, a sensor, a $0.10 MCU — except the one node doing the observing: the Intelligence itself. `self/context` / `self/memory` / `self/projects` are SINGLETON namespaces, and the console GUESSES which transcript is its own (`ls -t`, newest-wins). This surfaced THREE times on 2026-07-22 — the wrong-session transcript select, the multi-console `self/*` clobber, and "forgot which session." The peer model is complete everywhere but the self. Elegant completion: `self/<id>/*` + carried identity (passed, not guessed) = Intelligence-as-peer realized in the namespaces, not just the prose.

INSIGHT-BUS-CONTRACT-IS-IMPLICIT.title: The Canvas has a narrow waist; the bus does not

properties.observation: The Canvas contract is EXPLICIT — ~30 named primitives every backend meets. The BUS contract is IMPLICIT — namespace strings + payload shapes agreed only by convention. That is the exact family the "stale daemon serving an OLD payload shape" trap lives in: a shape change silently breaks a consumer, invisibly, because nothing declares the contract. A declared, typed, versioned narrow-waist FOR THE BUS would end that whole class the way the Canvas contract ended it for rendering — the same discipline, applied one layer over.
